name: @aiwg/cockpit
description: AIWG Cockpit — UX-first control plane over AIWG + multi-stack agentic sessions. Opt-in, separately published; NOT shipped in the base aiwg npm package (guarded by test/smoke/cockpit-base-footprint.test.js).

scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.smoke: node mock-executor/src/smoke.mjs && node bridge/src/smoke.mjs && node shell-core/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run test
scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run poc
scripts.check: npm run build:web && npm run test:web && npm run test
